title: cnidoscolus rotundifolius
intro: Cnidoscolus rotundifolius, commonly known as gilgai or calabash spinach, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cnidoscolus rotundifolius include acting as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
